snippet.title: The Guiding Spirit - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596380/The_Guiding_Spirit/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
